impact: The .deb Depends list (`package.json build.deb.depends`) does not include `pipewire (>= 0.3.x)` or `xdg-desktop-portal (>= 1.18)` as required by N-007 §17. A user installing the .deb on a system without these will get a successful dpkg install but the app will fail at runtime (no capture portal) with no install-time package-manager guidance. This directly blocks VAL-UI-014 (dep probe) and the packaging gate for T-010e.
resolution: Added pipewire (>= 0.3) and xdg-desktop-portal (>= 1.18) to package.json build.deb.depends. Verified with dpkg-deb -f: both entries present in generated .deb control file. Evidence: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-24-iss-017-deb-depends/dpkg-info.txt
title: v2.0.0 .deb Depends missing pipewire and xdg-desktop-portal per N-007 §17
